question: In which sport did Abhishek Verma win the Arjuna Award 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shooting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Abhishek Verma is an Indian sport shooter who has earned significant accolades in the sport of shooting.
 
• He has competed in the 10-meter air pistol events and has won numerous medals in international competitions.
 
• In recognition of his outstanding achievements in shooting, he was awarded the Arjuna Award in 2021.
 
• The Arjuna Award is one of the highest honors given by the Indian government to athletes for their exceptional performance in national sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arjuna Award:**

 
 
• The Arjuna Award was instituted in 1961 by the Government of India to recognize outstanding achievements in national sports.
 
• The award includes a bronze statuette of Arjuna, a certificate, ceremonial dress, and a cash prize.
 
• It aims to encourage and motivate athletes to achieve higher levels of performance.
 
• The selection committee considers athletes' performance over a period of four years and other factors such as leadership qualities, discipline, and sportsmanship.
 
 
 
• **Shooting Sport:**
 
 
• Shooting is a competitive sport involving tests of proficiency (accuracy and speed) using various types of guns such as firearms and airguns.
 
• In India, shooting has become increasingly popular, with Indian shooters excelling in various international competitions, including the Olympics.
 
• Some of the prominent shooting events include 10m air pistol, 10m air rifle, and 50m rifle events, among others.
 
• The National Rifle Association of India (NRAI) is the governing body for shooting sports in India.
